name: memory
description: reddb.io memory plugin - governed operational memory for code agents that lives on top of dev. Supports markdown notes, RedDB graph memory, zero-token governed recall, context packs, claim checks, readiness, optional lifecycle hooks, MCP/HTTP read surfaces, Workbench diagnostics, and Skill telemetry for self-improvement.

interface.shortDescription: Governed operational memory for code agents.
interface.longDescription: RedSkills Memory gives code agents governed operational memory that survives /clear and crosses sessions. It supports markdown-only notes and a RedDB-backed graph mode with repo ingest, zero-token governed recall, context packs, claim checks, readiness, graph export, optional lifecycle hooks, MCP/HTTP read access, Memory Workbench diagnostics, and Skill telemetry used by report-only curator diagnostics. Builds on the dev plugin processes.
defaultPrompt: Run $init to set up markdown-only notes or graph-backed governed memory.
Capture one scoped decision/gotcha/validation with $store, or extract durable facts with $extract.
Use $recall as the canonical governed context path, then verify with claim checks/readiness or inspect telemetry with $skills-status.
